displayName: AI Content Factory and Brand Consistency
description: Activate when: user says 'use AI to mass-produce content', 'how do we make AI write like our brand?', 'the AI content got facts wrong', 'how do we keep AI content out of legal trouble?', 'build a content factory', or plans 10+ AI-assisted pieces per week (blog, social, email, product pages) across several writers or agents. Do NOT activate when: writing a single one-off piece of copy; brand positioning and target customer are not yet decided (position first); the question is how content drives growth at all (use content-led-growth).
